latin: Potentia respectiua materiae non addit supra materiam rem, sed rationem.

mentions.context: Pico and Albert the Great 211 In thesis 16 we find that potency regarding matter does not add anything to matter beyond reason.91 In Albert’s commentary on Physics, Book 1, Tract. 3, Chapter 13, we read that matter, when it is intelligible but without privation and understood without form, is simple, but it is not in the end of simplicity.
